title: Benefits and recent reference pay
hook: Two stated cases: explore the reference wage behind a stated value comparison.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the reference wage behind a stated value comparison affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Value, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the reference wage behind a stated value comparison in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
